utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Good morning everyone. Let's go around. I spent yesterday on the memory tool filesystem layer — there's an edge case where the parent directory doesn't exist on write. Fix is up at https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/pull/9 referencing _beta_builtin_memory_tool.py, should land today.

utterances.speaker: Felix Becker
utterances.text: Quick question Robert — does that also cover the case where the tool gets a path traversal attempt? I noticed _filesystem.py doesn't validate parent paths against the workspace root.

utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Good catch, no. I'll add a follow-up issue for the path traversal. Marking it a known issue, not a blocker for the memory tool launch.

utterances.speaker: Packy Gallagher
utterances.text: I'm picking up the streaming refactor. The Stream class in _streaming.py has been accumulating retry logic that should really live in a separate RetryPolicy. Felix and I sketched the API last week. Aiming to have a PR up by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Qing Wang
utterances.text: I'm blocked on the agents resource — the beta_session_runner depends on a Stainless codegen change that hasn't landed. Eric is on it, should be sometime today. In the meantime I'm writing tests for the existing surface.

utterances.speaker: Robert Craigie
utterances.text: Decision: we'll cut the 0.112.0 release once the memory tool fix and Packy's streaming refactor are both in. Target Thursday EOD. Qing, your agents work can land in 0.113.

utterances.speaker: Felix Becker
utterances.text: Action item for me: spike on whether we should expose a sync API for the streaming retry policy, or async-only. I'll have an answer by tomorrow's standup.
